Definition: Ram, the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ram = "high" or "exalted"; 1) a Judaite, son of Hezron, father of Amminadab, and ancestor of David; 2) a Judaite, son of Jerahmeel; 3) a kindred of Elihu, the friend of Job
